name: Digital secondary test-mode indication
summary: Identifies the selected test or simulation state used by a digital-secondary application.
description: Identifies the selected test or simulation state used by a digital-secondary application. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Test or simulation status” at the input and “Digital test-mode indication” at the output. Test behavior must match the selected devices.
